reels.title: AgSpec: Pushing the Limits of Retrieval-Based Speculative Decoding in Coding Agent Pipelines

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper offers a high-utility mechanism for coding agents that directly addresses hardware bottlenecks, fitting our top-performing 'hardware_efficiency' category perfectly.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI coding assistant could 'copy-paste' its own thoughts to generate code 10x faster?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A library researcher who doesn't write new books from scratch but instead photographs entire paragraphs from existing shelves to build a new draft instantly.
